title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — September 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.2 (Peaked September 17, 2026 at 12:16 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 426 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Calm conditions right now. 🤍🌞

A broad coronal-hole-like region is visible in today’s solar EUV imagery, while the photosphere appears quiet.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
